about: Questions the Ask the trail button could not answer from the map's own data. Each entry is a to-do for Paul and Muse: Paul approves the work, Muse builds it. Written by the itm-save Worker's /ask endpoint (one commit per new question; repeat questions bump asked_count instead of duplicating).
